status: app-private presentation; no portable project or Core contract
binding: Explicit collection, entity and field IDs from authoritative table queries; saved selection order is stable and independent of view sorting/filtering.
sourceChanges: Existing selected subjects update from the current query. New rows are not automatically selected. Missing, failed, nonnumeric or unavailable source values disable current chart output; they never become zero or cached fallback values.
presentation: Title, categorical axis label, numeric axis label, series labels and legend visibility. Number/JPY/USD/percentage display inherits source presentation; mixed formats use plain Number without conversion.
persistence: Matching semantic bytes and private chart configuration share the existing atomic browser host record. Unknown configuration or collection identity rejects Open before resident replacement. Removed row/field bindings retain configuration with an explicit unavailable result.
sharing: Explicit current-chart static PNG download. Recheck revision, currentness, occurrence, configuration, formatting and pending data edits after asynchronous encoding. PNG is not editable, live-linked, a project backup or XLSX chart preservation.
xlsx: Editable charts are not preserved; disclose chart loss before spreadsheet download.
nonGoals: scatter or pie in this initial profile
